descriptions.notStarted: According to #p1101002#, I can take my Knighthood Exam if I see #b#p1101007##k, the Chief Knight of Lightning. I better head over to Ereve and meet #p1101007#.
descriptions.inProgress: The Knighthood Exam has started. The test itself is actually quite simple. I just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, and defeat the Mimis inside while bringing back #t4032100#. I better find #b30 #t4032100#s#k and bring them back to #p1101007#. \n\n#i4032100# #t4032100# #b#c4032100# / 30#k
descriptions.completed: I have successfully completed the Knighthood Exam and officially dropped the "in-Training" from my title. As a bonafide Cygnus Knight, I shall do my best to keep everything lighthearted and fun.
